title: Decimillipede Segment
move_pattern: Cycles through Constrict → Bulk → Writhe → Constrict. After death transitions to Dead → Reattach (mandatory heal) → random choice among the three main moves.
notes: Middle segment of the Decimillipede boss fight. Each segment has a unique HP value automatically adjusted to prevent duplicates among active segments. The three attack moves form a fixed cycle, with the starting move determined by the segment's index. When reduced to 0 HP, the segment enters a Dead state, then triggers Reattach (which heals and reattaches it via another segment), and finally randomly selects from the three main moves without repeating.
